title: Composition equation for canonical termwise maps on arbitrary singles
statement: Fix derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for all schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For maps i:T′→T, t:T→W, t′:T′→W with ht:i;t=t′ and any O_W-module M, let α_t(M) be canonicalSinglePullbackMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison] followed by the degree-zero single of the inverse adjunction-preserving tensor-to-ordinary pullback comparison. Thus α_t(M):Lt*(M[0])→Q((t_tensor* M)[0]) is a constructed morphism, without any flatness assumption. Let u be the single of tensorPullbackCompositionIso(i,t,t′,ht) [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], followed by the inverse singleMapHomologicalComplex comparison for i, and let η_i be picardTermwiseCounit [def-sc-picard-termwise-models]. For the pinned derived composition c [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], transported along ht, c.hom(M[0]);α_t′(M);Q(u.hom)=Li*(α_t(M));η_i((t_tensor* M)[0]). No invertibility of α is asserted.

proof.text: Eliminate ht by equality induction. Expand picardTermwiseSingleMap and canonicalSinglePullbackMap; functoriality cancels the single images of the unique-adjoint comparison and its inverse. The result is the pinned homotopy counit followed by the quotient of the tensor-pullback single-complex comparison.

Use the existing perfectHomTensorCounit_comp at the homotopy single of M. Its fixed counit and perfectHomComposition are exactly the choices in the statement, so this is c.hom;epsilon_(i;t) = Li(epsilon_t);epsilon_i;Qh(delta). The existing perfectHomTensorComp and its complex and homotopy lifts name delta without reconstructing its existential witnesses. The definition of tensorPullbackCompositionIso and inverse conjugate-isomorphism identities identify delta with the inverse tensor composition comparison.

Prove compatibility of singleMapHomologicalComplex with termwise composition by HomologicalComplex.to_single_hom_ext, evaluating at degree zero. Postcompose that equation with the single of the tensor composition comparison and the inverse single comparison for i. Cancel the two isomorphism pairs, then map the resulting equation through the homotopy and derived quotients. Substitute it into the counit factorization and apply naturality of epsilon_i to the single comparison for t.

Expand picardTermwiseCounit: quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors have identity components, so its component is the pinned homotopy counit in complex coordinates. This and the normalization in the first step identify the factorization-and-naturality equality with the required equation. No counit is canceled or inverted.

lean.statement:
theorem picardTermwiseSingleMap_composition
    {W T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
    (ht : i ≫ t = t') (M : W.Modules) :
    let : (Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive :=
      (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).left_adjoint_additive
    let u := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) 0).mapIso
        ((Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso i t t' ht).app M) ≪≫
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (Modules.tensorPullback i) (.up ℤ) 0).app ((Modules.tensorPullback t).obj M)).symm
    let c := (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) i t ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun g : T' ⟶ W ↦ derivedPullback g) ht)
    c.hom.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M) ≫
        picardTermwiseSingleMap t' M ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map u.hom =
      (derivedPullback i).map (picardTermwiseSingleMap t M) ≫
        (picardTermwiseCounit i).app ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback t).obj M))
